chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Fadalah, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Whatever of your prayer you missed due to an illness in which you lost consciousness, make it up when you regain consciousness."
ai.seo_question: How to make up missed prayers after losing consciousness due to illness?
ai.summary: Reported by Imam al-Sadiq (AS) in *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith clarifies the specific ruling for *qada* (making up) prayers missed during periods of unconsciousness (*ghafla*) caused by illness. It establishes that the obligation to compensate for these missed obligatory prayers is lifted only if the individual was completely unaware of the prayer times, emphasizing the principle of ease (*rukhas*) in Shia jurisprudence for those incapacitated by health issues.
